verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on HR-system sync, employee onboarding or offboarding checklists, security-training completion tracking, or event-driven deprovisioning proof. The closest items are periodic user access reviews and policy acknowledgment workflows, which are adjacent but do not deliver HR-synced joiner/leaver compliance events. The Onboarding Mode material covers setting up the Thoropass app itself, not workforce onboarding.
